data.name: VELVET HOWLER
data.description: Emerald lacquer, gold wire-spoke repulsors and cream leather turn a classic lowrider into a zero-g cruiser. Twin thrusters deliver strong nitro with gold music-note particles. Pilot: Asilbek, an original hound racer.

data.name: SNOUT ROCKET
data.description: A black-and-chrome rocker on a hover hull, with two guitar-headstock fins and one big pink snout for an engine. Every boost snorts out a cloud of little pig noses.
